promised.clause: every write accepted before it survives a crash
all or nothing, one WAL record
unmoved by later writes and compactions
the engine refuses writes until reopened
recovery returns a prefix of accepted writes, including every synced write
damage before an authenticated later sync marker is reported as corruption
the older log is durable before writes in the newer generation can become durable

examples.python:
# From a Linux source checkout, build and install first:
# cargo build --release -p kiban-ffi
# python -m pip install ./bindings/python
# Installed packages also need KIBAN_LIB pointing to libkiban_ffi.so.
from kiban import Kiban

with Kiban("example-db") as db:
    db.put("hello", "world")
    db.sync()  # writes require sync for crash durability
    assert db.get("hello") == b"world"
    with db.snapshot() as view:
        db.put("hello", "again")
        assert view.get("hello") == b"world"
